text:
Hannah: Found a mason jar labeled 'Kombucha Council - DO NOT DISTURB' in the fridge. Is that...official now?
Pri: Official, yes. We established it at last hackday. The SCOBY has an attendance sheet.
Liam: The SCOBY demanded snacks and a tiny sombrero. I complied.
Noor: tiny sombrero? Of course. Are we assigning a kombucha custodian or is it a rotating rota?
Hannah: proposal: weekly custodian called 'Captain Culture'. Duties: taste-test, top-up sweet tea, log pH (if you're into that).
Felix: I volunteer as tribute but only if taste-testing includes blind samples. Scientific method.
Jules: also suggestion: brew-tax 1% of snack stash goes to kombucha upkeep. It's for the culture (literally).
Pri: brew-tax sounds aggressive but fair. Can we pay in granola bars?
Liam: poll created: "Who should be Captain Culture for next week?" 3 options: Felix; Hannah; Liam; Rotating. React with :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote.
ops-bot: poll created: "Who should be Captain Culture for next week?" 3 options: Felix; Hannah; Liam; Rotating. React with :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote.
hr-bot: Reminder: please label fermented items with allergen and date. Avoid leaving things unlabelled overnight.
Hannah: noted. added a tiny label: "Do Not Drink Unless Brave" with a smiley.
Noor: also, we need kombucha custody rules: 1) if you take a sip, leave a polite note. 2) no re-gifting homemade jars without consent. 3) no office kombucha experiments involving hot sauce.
Felix: hot sauce experiment denied. cursed idea.
Liam: log suggestion: an analog ledger by the fridge titled 'Kombucha Chronicles' where people can jot flavors and mood.
Jules: mood tracking: Tuesday = Tangy; Friday = Philosophical.
Pri: I made a tiny sticker set: SCOBY crest, "Captain Culture", and "I tried the mystery jar" for the ledger. Jamie (Design) will be proud.
Hannah: we should make a small ceremony when we switch captains. Tiny handoff: hat + spoon. Rituals increase compliance.
Noor: agree. I'll bring a tiny bell for the ceremony.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Kombucha Handoff Ceremony' Monday 10:00 in kitchen.
Felix: Captain duties also include updating a shared note with brew schedule. I can set that up.
Jules: final rule: if kombucha turns into something suspiciously bubbly and purple, call ops immediately.
Pri: adding emotional addendum: if kombucha makes you lyrical, please share poems in #random.
Hannah: we have created yet another office micro-culture. Very Redwood.
Noor: long live the SCOBY.
Liam: may it remain tangy and not judgemental.
